scope: One native kernel-wait measurement on upgraded Stellar Xbox; 1000 samples per case, no SDL/audio initialization or AC97 access.
interpretation: Observed calls did not undershoot their requested durations. No measured basis to replace the HAL cold-reset delay as a startup fix. This did not measure the actual reset pulse or establish an audio root cause.
full_evidence: workspace logs/hardware/timer-granularity-first with BUILD-INFO.json and provenance/
